scope: Static admission/player lifecycle evidence and aggregate matching in an earlier normal-client reconnect capture. Independent-client runtime results are recorded separately.

admissionMethods.finding: Reads antiId/antiToken with StringRaw limits 128/2048; no direct empty-string rejection in this reader. Steam ticket validation is separate.
Calls OnJoinGame and waits while active, not rejected, and authStatusEAC is empty.
The configured nonsecure/editor server path invokes local and remote callbacks, establishing dictionary status 2. This branch does not demonstrate a protected EAC client session.
Protected path parses ProductUserId and calls RegisterClient; managed caller discards Result. Exact SDK behavior for an empty/invalid ID was not exercised.
Sets dictionary status 1; sets authStatusEAC to ok when strictauth_eac is false and the status string is empty.
Sets dictionary status 2; sets authStatusEAC to ok when strictauth_eac is true and the status string is empty.
Remote status callback constructs an ID token and calls VerifyIdToken.
When token validation applies, failed validation or Steam account mismatch causes Kick. No token bodies are retained here.
Unauthenticated connections are kicked after server.authtimeout; the static default is 60 seconds.
Requires Steam, EAC, Nexus, CentralizedBans and PremiumServer status strings all equal ok.

playerLifecycleMethods.finding: Requires Welcoming state 3, sets Connected state 4, marks JoinedGame and calls a player spawn path.
Adds the player to activePlayerList and activePlayerLookup before EnterGame.
ReceivingSnapshot path waits for an empty SnapshotQueue and EACServer.IsAuthenticated before EnterGame.
Returns whether the connection dictionary status equals 2. The configured nonsecure/editor path also supplies this status.
Clears ReceivingSnapshot flag 8 and sends player-targeted FinishLoading ClientRPC.
Builds cp from activePlayerList.Count; simultaneous other joins/leaves can confound remote count comparisons.

finishLoadingRpc.hashAlgorithm: Lowercase string, UTF-8, MD5, BitConverter.ToUInt32(digest, 0); little endian on observed Windows platform

normalClientCapture.sourceKind: Earlier normal-client reconnect, not an independent-client run
normalClientCapture.matchingScope: Only verified unsplit inbound RPC frame payload+9; entity IDs skipped. Split RPCs are outside this count.

disconnectEnvelope.format: 0x9a + reasonByteLength:uint32LE + reason:UTF-8; reliable immediate send, then close

limitations: World messages alone do not establish a self-owned player entity or completion of EnterGame.
FinishLoading in a normal-client capture validates the observable marker; independent-client admission and persistence require separate runtime evidence.
No remote private server configuration, exact active-player list, or protected EAC client lifecycle is established by this file.
Method metadata tokens and IL offsets apply to the module hashes above.

privacy.included: Method names, metadata tokens, IL offsets, module hashes, protocol constants and aggregate counts only
